note: User-controlled NUL-terminated heap string (raw fuzz input) is handed to the date parser.
The raw input string, which is not valid UTF-8, is passed to the parse-token filler.
Fewer than 3 integer tokens were found in the input, so the invalid-UTF-8 heap string is casefolded.
Scanning loop walks the whole string; its condition dereferences *p on every iteration, including for the trailing invalid UTF-8 lead byte.

g_utf8_next_char() is a macro that advances p by g_utf8_skip[*p] (1..6 bytes) without validating; for a trailing multi-byte lead byte (e.g. 0xC3) it moves p past the NUL terminator and beyond the end of the heap buffer.
On the next iteration the loop condition dereferences *p one or more bytes past the end of the heap allocation: heap-buffer-overflow read.
